title: Selling Plans Term Change Fee Multiplier for Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Stock
content:
Sellers who keep stock in the Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) network pay a reduced term change fee when their **Selling Plans** store moves from the annual to the monthly term. The multiplier reads the seller's FBN enrollment: its status and the units on hand it shows.

**Rule.** The term change fee is finally multiplied by the large-stock FBN multiplier when the seller's FBN enrollment is active and holds at least the large FBN stock of units on hand, by the FBN multiplier when it is active and holds some units but fewer than that, and by one otherwise.

The multiplication is the last step applied to the fee amount, and the result is rounded to the nearest cent after it.

## Multiplier table

| FBN enrollment status | Units on hand | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 500 or more (the large FBN stock) | 0.5 (large-stock FBN multiplier) |
| Active | 1 to 499 | 0.8 (FBN multiplier) |
| Active | 0 | One |
| Any status other than active, or no enrollment | Any | One |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

A fee amount of USD 25.50 before this step:

- active enrollment, 500 units → 25.50 times 0.5 is USD 12.75;
- active enrollment, 499 units → 25.50 times 0.8 is USD 20.40;
- active enrollment, 0 units → USD 25.50.
